calls.statement:
WITH treated AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key) WHERE x.campaign_id = 15),
held AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
grp AS (SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS grp FROM treated UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM held),
sales AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key)
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag),
refunds AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, -r.refund_net AS amt FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key)
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag),
spend AS (SELECT member_id, sum(amt) AS spend FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM refunds) GROUP BY 1),
per_group AS (
  SELECT g.grp, count(*) AS members, sum(coalesce(s.spend, 0)) AS total, avg(coalesce(s.spend, 0)) AS avg_spend
  FROM grp g LEFT JOIN spend s USING (member_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT * FROM per_group
UNION ALL SELECT 'uplift', NULL, NULL, (SELECT avg_spend FROM per_group WHERE grp='targeted') - (SELECT avg_spend FROM per_group WHERE grp='holdout')

WITH treated AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key) WHERE x.campaign_id = 15),
held AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
grp AS (SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS grp FROM treated UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM held),
pre AS (SELECT m.member_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS spend FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key)
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2025-11-23' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag GROUP BY 1)
SELECT g.grp, count(*) n, avg(coalesce(p.spend,0)) pre_avg FROM grp g LEFT JOIN pre p USING (member_id) GROUP BY 1

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_key) k, (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates) stg, (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member)) stg_overlap FROM dim_member

WITH treated AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key) WHERE x.campaign_id = 15),
held AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
grp AS (SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS grp FROM treated UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM held),
sales AS (

  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag),
spend AS (SELECT member_id, sum(amt) AS spend FROM sales GROUP BY 1)
SELECT g.grp, avg(coalesce(s.spend,0)) avg_gross_of_returns FROM grp g LEFT JOIN spend s USING (member_id) GROUP BY 1
